title: ID0389654-DC/Si-D/NL[R7VjM6] - ELMS activation
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
We’re trying to implement an ELMS system at charger R7VjM6. Please find below the router settings. ELMS is activated. The ELMS controller has IP address 192.168.202.95 We’re unable to establish communication between the controller and the charger. From the manual it’s not exactly clear what the IP of the charger is. Is this the 192.168.202.112, if so, can we change this to .92? The message we receive when trying to communicate with .112 it gives the econ refused.

N/A

additional_info.subject: ELMS activation
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
We’re trying to implement an ELMS system at charger R7VjM6.
Please find below the router settings. ELMS is activated.
The ELMS controller has IP address 192.168.202.95
We’re unable to establish communication between the controller and the charger. From the manual it’s not exactly clear what the IP of the charger is. Is this the 192.168.202.112, if so, can we change this to .92?
The message we receive when trying to communicate with .112 it gives the econ refused.
